name: Big Run Campground
why: duplicate of 88 Big Run State Park: same booking listing (parkReservations parkId 380102), same 27 sites, same fees, pins 60 m apart (AWH 2026-10-12: combine). 88 keeps its id, name, pin and rating; it takes 89's waterfront-map evidence. 89's booking group (reservation only, no walk-ins) came from Savage River State Forest's page and describes the forest's own Big Run Area sites 123-144, not the park's, so 88 got the park page's rule instead.
